subject: Re: POC extension & conditional package offer — Wavefront AI
messages:
From: Cara Liu <cara@wavefront.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@wavefront.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extend evaluation window & pricing conversation

Hi Hannah —

Quick context: our engineering team hit a blocker integrating our event stream with the SDK (third-party connector issue) and the POC runway will end before we have a reliable test surface. We really like Redwood's latency and cost profile, but without a few more test days we can't make a conversion recommendation.

Two asks:
- Can we extend the time-boxed evaluation by 3 weeks (same seat count and concurrency) so we can finish the integration and run a load pass?
- Given the extra time and the fact we won't be converting immediately, is there flexibility on an interim discount for the extension period? Even a partial credit or % off would help get procurement approval.

I attached our security questionnaire (for your CS team) and can share a short usage forecast if that helps. Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Cara Liu
Director of ML Platform
Wavefront AI

Attachments: wavefront-security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Liu <cara@wavefront.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extend evaluation window & pricing conversation

Hi Cara —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the questionnaire. Sorry to hear about the connector trouble — totally understand needing more time. We can support two paths depending on what you prefer:

1) Time-box extension (recommended):
- Add 3 weeks to the existing pilot with no change in seats/concurrency.
- During the extension period we can provide a one-time 20% credit applied to tokens consumed during those 3 weeks (credit will appear on the final invoice).

2) Conditional conversion incentive:
- Add 3 weeks as above, and if Wavefront converts to a paid Dedicated or Reserved pilot within 60 days of the extension end, we can provide a conversion credit equal to 30% of the extension's billed amount (applied as an offset to month 1 of the committed contract).

Operational notes: we generally avoid long-term automatic discounts for evaluation extensions, but we can do time-limited credits and conversion-backed incentives. If procurement needs an invoice/line item we can produce a pro forma showing the credit.

Ben — looping you in for the SLA/ops side and to confirm we can schedule a brief handoff so our SDK team pairs with Cara's engineers. Marissa — if finance wants to review the credit / conversion terms I copied you.

If that approach works, I can pull together a short amendment and Ben can attach a draft SLA for the extension. Call windows: I have 9–11am PT tomorrow or 3–4pm PT Friday.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Cara Liu <cara@wavefront.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extend evaluation window & pricing conversation

Hi Cara / Hannah —

Thanks — I can own the ops/SLA draft for the 3-week extension. A few practical details and one alternative packaging option to consider:

Operational checklist:
- We will provision the same concurrent QPS and seats for +3 weeks; no auto-scaling changes unless you request.
- I will schedule a 60-minute pairing session between our SDK team and your engs to unblock the connector (propose Thu 8/13 10:00am PT).
- I'll include usage logging with token-level breakdown so you get a clean handoff to procurement.

Packaging / discount options (pick one):
A) Extension credit: one-time 20% credit on extension consumption (Hannah's suggested).
B) Surge bucket + smaller credit: provide a 50k token surge bucket (no charge up to bucket), plus a 10% extension credit on consumption beyond the bucket. This keeps overall spend exposure lower while letting you run load.

Contract note: if you want the conversion incentive (Hannah's 30% conversion credit), we'll add a short amendment that ties the credit to a signed order for Dedicated / Reserved within 60 days of the extension end. We can remove auto-renew for the extension amendment if procurement requests, but the conversion credit will require the signed order window.

Attached: POC-extension-SLA-draft.pdf (SLA + amendment template). If procurement needs an official quote, Marissa can push the approval to Finance to produce a pro forma invoice with the chosen credit structure.

Next steps:
- Cara: confirm which packaging (A or B) you'd prefer and whether you need auto-renew removed from the extension amendment.
- If yes, I'll send the amendment (DocuSign) and schedule the SDK pairing.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachments: POC-extension-SLA-draft.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Cara Liu <cara@wavefront.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, procurement@wavefront.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extend evaluation window & pricing conversation

Hi Hannah / Ben —

Thanks for the quick responses and the options. We'd like to move forward with option B (surge bucket + 10% credit) because it gives our SREs room to run the load test without surprising spend. Two quick asks on the amendment:

1) Please remove the auto-renew clause for the extension period — procurement won't sign otherwise.
2) Can you include a one-line commitment that the conversion credit (if we convert) will not be rescinded if we need a minor scope change during onboarding? Procurement flagged that as a risk.

We'll confirm the pairing session Thursday at 10:00am PT. Also, procurement asked us to get the pro forma showing the credit and the surge bucket line-item so they can process an internal approval — Marissa, can you help with that?

I'll also share the final security questionnaire answers later today.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the pairing call.

Best,
Cara

Attachments: (uploaded earlier)
